approach: Execute 300 runs with the validated CPU reference as eight OMP=1 processes. Gate the last two non-overlapping 144-snapshot windows separately for tail dynamics, adjacent-window stability, and independent-seed precision while retaining temporal ESS as a reported diagnostic.
runtime_basis: V1C consumed 45.38 CPU-hours for 225 runs at total_time=3000. Scaling by 300/225 and 4500/3000 estimates 90.76 CPU-hours and 11.35 wall-hours at parallel=8.
storage_estimate: Approximately 50 GB; all heavy artifacts remain under the ignored job workspace.
evidence_boundary: V1E can validate the numerical and steady-estimand premises for later experiments, but cannot support a landscape-effect claim.
